faq.question: Where is AzuriteCon?
faq.answer: AzuriteCon will be held at 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042.

faq.question: When does online ticket sales end?
faq.answer: Online Eventbrite ticket sales end Thursday, 15 April 2027.

faq.question: How much is entry?
faq.answer: Market Entry is $8 plus booking fees online, or $11 on the day. Saturday Market + Panels & Performances is $15 plus booking fees online only. Kids aged 12 years or under are $4 on the day.

faq.question: How do I apply for Artist Alley?
faq.answer: Use the Artist Alley application form linked on the website.
